dynamicStrategy: All per-client documents (intake, proposal, integration-deck, client-portal) are dynamic — loaded from Firestore at runtime. Static resources (architect-guide, ds-pricing-model) are regenerated from MD source files when content changes.

templates.name: Intake Questionnaire
templates.purpose: Client fills in their integration requirements, systems, and constraints. Submitted to Firestore. Regenerated by Scout when knowledge grows.
templates.frozenNote: commons/templates/intake-template.html is FROZEN. Do not modify without explicit user approval. The current design (collapsible sections + UCs, compact Q grid, sticky bar, section tiles, white-page standards) is the approved baseline as of 2026-05-14. Warn the user before making any CSS or structural changes.
templates.notes: Sticky submit bar + Firestore save. No mailto. Success banner on completion.

templates.name: Proposal
templates.purpose: Per-client engagement proposal covering challenge, solution, flows, pricing, timeline, and next steps. Sent to client.
templates.notes: Pricing computed from commons/sales/pricing-model.md. Never hardcode rates.

templates.name: Integration Deck
templates.purpose: Per-client deep-research pitch deck with FOMO data, nearby peer examples, talking points, and AI journey narrative. Shared with client before or alongside proposal.
templates.notes: Requires web research in Scout Session 3a. Content sourced from company_context.json competitorFOMO and nearbyPeers.

templates.name: Client Portal
templates.purpose: Per-client project hub showing documents, sprint status, and architect contact. Client bookmarks this URL throughout the engagement.
templates.notes: DS Pricing Model card is hardcoded in template — always present. Other doc cards filled per-client.

templates.name: Architect Portal
templates.purpose: Internal engagement management hub. Shows all active clients, intake response status, and links to all internal resource docs.
templates.notes: Firebase Google auth gated to @dataskate.ai. Projects loaded from projects-manifest.json.

templates.name: DS Pricing Model
templates.purpose: Client-facing print-ready one-pager (A4) summarising both engagement models, rate schedule, and Phase 2 AI upsell. Leave-behind for discovery calls.
templates.notes: Print layout (210mm wide). Rates parsed from commons/sales/pricing-model.md — never hardcoded.

templates.name: Architect Guide
templates.purpose: Single internal reference for architects. Covers the full DataSkate proposition, pricing, AE briefing, client objections, email templates, and Phase 2 pivot. Replaces the former AE Pitch Kit and Client Pitch Kit.
templates.notes: Pricing section references commons/sales/pricing-model.md — never hardcode rates in this file.

accessRules.internal: Firebase Google auth required, restricted to @dataskate.ai accounts
accessRules.external: Publicly accessible — no login required. Share via direct link or embed in client portal.

categories.sales: Sales and pre-sales materials for prospect and AE use
categories.delivery: Active engagement tools for architects and clients
